title: Pan-Fried Dumplings with Spicy Sauce
description: A classic Chinese dish featuring pan-fried dumplings served with a spicy sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the dumplings and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and hot sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the dumplings are coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pan-fried dumplings hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
Note: You can also serve the dumplings with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple salad.
